name: Ping An Biomedical Co. Ltd.
summary: Ping An Biomedical Co., Ltd. delivers comprehensive supply chain management services tailored for the clothing sector. The company furnishes integrated solutions to its clients, covering a wide spectrum of offerings from initial yarn products and various textiles to fully manufactured garments. Its operations are organized into two primary divisions: Yarns and Finished Garments. Established in 2013 by Yuk Yin Li and Sek Yan Ko, the firm's main office is situated in Hong Kong.
